# function: base64gzip

Compresses the given string with gzip and then encodes the result to Base64 using the standard alphabet, matching the behaviour of the built-in `base64gzip` function.



## Signature

<!-- signature generated by tfplugindocs -->
```text
base64gzip(str string) string
```

## Arguments

<!-- arguments generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `str` (String) The string to compress and encode.
